project.description: The single maven reactor build of the pic-sure monorepo. Every image job consumes this job's per-stack workspace; no other job runs Maven against the monorepo. Fail-closed: build-info.txt is removed before maven and rewritten only on success. Builds are serialized (concurrentBuild=false) because the per-stack workspace is shared and concurrent same-stack runs corrupt it; orchestrated runs additionally hold lock(stack-<stack>). Do not run manually while a pipeline holds that stack's lock.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: MODULES
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Optional comma-separated reactor module paths to build (with -am for upstream deps), e.g. services/pic-sure-logging. Empty builds the full monorepo.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail
: "${TARGET_STACK:?TARGET_STACK is required}"
GIT_BRANCH_SHORT=$(echo "${GIT_BRANCH}" | awk -F/ '{print $NF}') GIT_COMMIT_SHORT=$(echo "${GIT_COMMIT}" | cut -c1-7)
# Fail closed: image jobs must not consume a mixed lane after a failed build. rm -f build-info.txt
# Optional targeted build: when MODULES is set, build only those reactor modules # (plus their upstream deps via -am) instead of the full monorepo. Empty = full # build, so the full Pipeline jobs (which pass no MODULES) are unchanged. MVN_GOALS="-B clean install -T1C -DskipTests" if [ -n "${MODULES:-}" ]; then MVN_GOALS="$MVN_GOALS -pl ${MODULES} -am" fi echo "mvn goals: $MVN_GOALS"
# The reactor build for this stack's lane. Identity-map mount (BDC: # host path == container path); per-stack m2 avoids concurrent-install races. docker run --rm \ -v "/var/jenkins_home/workspace/PIC-SURE Maven Build - ${TARGET_STACK}/:/app:z" \ -v "maven_m2_cache_${TARGET_STACK}:/root/.m2" \ -w /app \ --platform=linux/amd64 \ maven:3-amazoncorretto-25 \ sh -lc "mvn $MVN_GOALS"
# Tag metadata for the image jobs (they source this file). { echo "GIT_BRANCH_SHORT=$GIT_BRANCH_SHORT" echo "GIT_COMMIT_SHORT=$GIT_COMMIT_SHORT" } > build-info.txt cat build-info.txt
